name: Bruno
blurb: Bruno is a Fast and Git-Friendly API client.
description:
Bruno is a Fast and Git-Friendly API client. Bruno stores your collections directly in a folder on your filesystem. We use a plain text markup language, Bru, to save information about API requests.

• Stores your collections in a folder on your filesystem

• Use git for collaboration

• No cloud sync. Fully offline.

• Majority of our features are free and have been opensourced under the MIT license.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.

install.label: Get it from GitHub
install.note: Releases, or build from source. Spruce never hosts the binaries.
